subject: Redlines: VPC addendum — records access, operator boundary, evidence routing
messages:
From: Gina Park <gpark@medallionhealth.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, legal@redwood.com
Cc: Tom Harlow <tharlow@medallionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T09:12:00-07:00
Subject: VPC addendum — operator access & evidence routing questions

Hi Marissa,

Thanks for the quick demo last week. Legal asked me to consolidate a short list of asks they want addressed in the VPC addendum so we can proceed with procurement. Two primary areas:

1) Territorial / records access scope — we need clarity on what logs and forensic artifacts Redwood will provide during a jurisdictional audit (customer-initiated or regulator request). Are snapshots of runtime images included, or only runbook artifacts and operator witness options?

2) Operator and support access boundary — we need explicit language about whether Redwood engineers will ever have console access into the tenant VPC for troubleshooting, and if so, under what conditions, audit windows, and witness options.

I attached a short evidence matrix our security team put together (medallion_evidence_matrix_20261001.xlsx) and a candidate redline doc (placeholder). Can your legal team propose language or mark up the MSA + Order Form addendum that addresses: scope of deliverables for an audit, timeframe for evidence delivery, and an escrow-like alternative (sealed snapshot deposit / designated witness) if console access is disallowed?

Target timeline: our CISO wants this wrapped by the end of next week (10/4). Please let me know who on your side should be looped for technical constraints.

Cheers,
Gina Park
Sr. IT Security, Medallion Health

Attachments: medallion_evidence_matrix_20261001.xlsx (spreadsheet)

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Gina Park <gpark@medallionhealth.com>, Medallion Legal <legal@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-27T11:03:00-07:00
Subject: Re: VPC addendum — operator access & evidence routing questions

Gina — thanks for the clear list and the matrix. I’ll coordinate legal + engineering and propose redlines back by 10/1.

Quick notes:
- I understand the ask for a sealed-snapshot/escrow-like pathway as an alternative to live console access. We’ve done a witnessed snapshot workflow with other health customers; that typically involves a timeboxed window, a witness party, and transfer of digest-only proof artifacts to the customer.
- For operator access, Marcus can outline minimal escalation-only access patterns and the telemetry we can commit to hand over without granting interactive console sessions.

Laura — can you lead on a draft addendum and highlight any MSA cross-references we need to change? Marcus — can you give a short bullet list of what telemetry/forensics we can provide from runtime (KV caches, logs, snapshots) and what would require image export?

I’ll schedule a 30 minute sync for early next week to walk through the redline.

Thanks — Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Attachment referenced: medallion_evidence_matrix_20261001.xlsx

From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Gina Park <gpark@medallionhealth.com>, Medallion Legal <legal@medallionhealth.com>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-09-29T08:45:00-07:00
Subject: Draft redlines: VPC Addendum (summary and next steps)

Marissa / Gina — attaching a marked-up draft (Medallion_VPC_Addendum_Redline_20261001.docx). Summary of the primary changes I propose so the team can react quickly: 

1) Audit scope and deliverables — we propose enumerating deliverables by artifact category rather than by nebulous "snapshot" language. Example categories: (a) system/serving logs (timestamped request traces), (b) configuration manifests (deployed model image version/quantization), (c) access/operation runbooks, (d) sealed forensic snapshot (binary image) — the latter will only be delivered via a witnessed process or sealed-deposit.

2) Evidence delivery timeline — propose 10 business days for delivery of log/config artifacts; 30 business days for a sealed snapshot request subject to legal process and witness scheduling. If timelines conflict with your audit window, we can negotiate expedited delivery (fees may apply).

3) Operator access / escalation — add a clause: interactive console access by Redwood personnel is disallowed except under a documented escalation process (customer-written trigger form + dual-authorization), and any temporary access must be via a time-limited break-glass session with real-time recording and post-access attestation.

4) Witnessed snapshot / sealed-deposit workflow — added an exhibit that outlines the witness protocol (two-party witness, notarized receipt, integrity digest checks). This is our standard compromise when customers want no persistent operator access.

5) Redaction & PII handling — call out that forensic artifacts may include masked PII; Redwood will apply agreed redaction rules and provide a redaction log.

Open items where input is required from Medallion:
- Is a 30-business-day window for sealed snapshot acceptable?
- Do you require onshore-only witness options (US-only vs US+EU)?
- Any mandatory regulator-driven evidence formats?

If those three bullets are answerable, we can finalize the language and roll into the Order Form. Marcus — I left two tech comments inline re: KV cache snapshots and model weight export.

Laura Bennett
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference

Attachments: Medallion_VPC_Addendum_Redline_20261001.docx (redline)

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, Gina Park <gpark@medallionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-09-30T14:18:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft redlines: VPC Addendum (summary and next steps)

Quick technical clarifications (short bullets):
- KV cache: we can persist and export KV cache snapshots (digest+metadata) but full in-memory runtime state with unquantized weights is not practical to export on short notice.
- Model images: exportable but requires an offline export window; image sizes are large and will require transfer staging (we recommend the sealed-snapshot workflow).
- Logs & traces: we can commit to 30 days of high-fidelity request traces and 365 days of aggregated telemetry by default (configurable in Order Form).
- Access pattern: we support break-glass sessions implemented as ephemeral bastion tunnels with live session recording and signed attestations post-session.

If Medallion wants model weight-level artifacts, we need an explicit support plan and likely a separate procurement line (storage/transfer costs).

—Marcus
Principal Systems Engineer, Redwood Inference

From: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: Gina Park <gpark@medallionhealth.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Medallion Legal <legal@medallionhealth.com>
Date: 2026-10-01T16:45:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Draft redlines: VPC Addendum (summary and next steps)

Thanks everyone for the fast turnaround — this is helpful. Action items and asks to close by 10/04: 

1) Gina/Medallion: confirm whether 30 business days for sealed snapshots is acceptable, and whether you require US-only witnessing. Reply to this thread with a one-line confirmation so Laura can lock language.
2) Medallion Legal: please review the redline doc and flag any non-starters. We’ll plan a 30-minute sign-off call on 10/04 if needed.
3) Marcus: please prepare a short cost estimate for expedited image export (if Medallion wants weight-level artifacts) and a brief note on transfer logistics (S3 presigned / courier).

If Medallion confirms the 30-day window and US-only witness, Laura will prepare the final addendum for signature and I will circulate a DocuSign link. I’ve also added the HubSpot deal (see link) and attached the redline + matrix for ease.

DocuSign placeholder: https://na1.docusign.net/prepare/placeholder/DL-2026-091

Best — Marissa
Director, Strategic Accounts, Redwood Inference

Attachment(s): Medallion_VPC_Addendum_Redline_20261001.docx, medallion_evidence_matrix_20261001.xlsx
